welcomeTitle: Which company shall we talk about?
welcomeText: Describe the company — what it does, its legal form, the licences or certificates it holds — and upload its internal policies or procedures. The assistant builds the company profile, reads the documents, checks their references to legal acts and works out which financial market the company operates in, which institutes of financial law govern it and which licence it needs. With a filled profile you can run the automated compliance analysis with a report (PDF / Excel).
suggestion1: Our UAB provides crypto-asset exchange and custody services in Lithuania, 40 employees. Which licence do we need and which institutes of financial law apply?
suggestion2: Assess 1009 LTD's compliance with MiCA and DORA.
suggestion3: Check whether the MiCA articles cited in our uploaded policy really govern what it says they do.

NOTICE.title: About the AI assistant
NOTICE.full:
You are talking to an artificial intelligence (AI) assistant. Its answers may be inaccurate, incomplete or outdated — check the cited legal acts and sources before relying on them.
Your messages and uploaded documents are processed through the university's AI gateway (ai.knf.vu.lt).
The assistant's conclusions are not legal advice.

ERRORS.title: Chat error
ERRORS.RATE_LIMITED: Too many questions in a row. Wait {seconds} s and try again.
ERRORS.RATE_LIMITED_NOWAIT: Too many questions in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
ERRORS.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Your AI usage limit for today is spent. Try again tomorrow.
ERRORS.AI_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The AI service budget is exhausted — try again later or contact the administrator.
ERRORS.MODEL_TIMEOUT: The answer took too long and was cut off. Try a narrower question or try again.
ERRORS.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The AI model is unavailable right now. Try again in a few minutes.
ERRORS.MODEL_REFUSED: This model can't answer this request. Pick another model below the message field and generate the answer again.
ERRORS.MODEL_CONTEXT_EXCEEDED: The conversation has grown too long for the model. Start a new conversation.
ERRORS.MODEL_CONTENT_FILTERED: The AI provider's content filter blocked this request. Rephrase the message and send it again.
ERRORS.MODEL_ACCESS_DENIED: The AI service refused the assistant's access — contact the administrator.
ERRORS.STREAM_FAILED: The assistant could not finish the answer. Try again.
ERRORS.NOT_CONFIGURED: The assistant is not configured yet — contact the administrator.
ERRORS.PROMPT_NOT_CONFIGURED: The assistant has no active instructions — an administrator must activate them.
ERRORS.PROMPT_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant's instructions could not be loaded. Try again in a few seconds.
ERRORS.THREAD_NOT_FOUND: The conversation was not found or is not yours.
ERRORS.INPUT_TOO_LARGE: The message is too long. Shorten it or upload the text as a document.
ERRORS.INVALID: The request was invalid — reload the page and try again.
ERRORS.SESSION: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
ERRORS.NETWORK: No connection to the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
ERRORS.RESTARTING: The assistant is restarting (an update is being installed, for example). Try again in a moment.
ERRORS.HISTORY: The conversation history could not be prepared. Start a new conversation or try later.
ERRORS.THREAD_NOT_CREATED: The conversation could not be created. Try again.
ERRORS.UNKNOWN: The assistant's answer could not be received. Try again.
